plan.title: Modules 6-8: Work Shaping, Lifecycle Authorization, and Session Workflow

narratives.Description: Teach how an idea becomes demonstrable work, how lifecycle state grants bounded implementation authority, and how sessions select authorized work. The work includes vertical-slice shaping, lifecycle preflight, and intake/posture exercises.
narratives.Acceptance: Learners write observable acceptance criteria, turn a horizontal plan into a vertical slice, recognize epic decomposition, use lifecycle commands rather than file moves, observe proposed-scope preflight failure and active-scope success, distinguish read-only and mutation-ready posture, recover sessions, and apply ordered-plan precedence before the ranked queue.
narratives.Traces: PROJECT-DEFINITION LearningGoals: work shaping and observable acceptance; lifecycle and implementation authorization; session start and ordered work selection
narratives.QualityGate: Run task deft:check separately as the aggregate merge chokepoint after the literal acceptance command; do not embed the aggregate gate in plan.acceptance.commands.

items.title: Author Module 6 and vertical-slice shaping exercise

narrative.Acceptance: A learner transforms a fictional horizontal technical plan into a coherent, demonstrable vertical slice with observable acceptance and explains when decomposition is required.

items.title: Author Module 7 and lifecycle authorization lab

narrative.Acceptance: A disposable fixture demonstrates fail-closed preflight in proposed state, correct promotion and activation through verified lifecycle commands, successful preflight, reset, and cleanup.
A learner classifies requests by session posture and traces ordered-plan, ranked-queue, accepted-backlog, cache, and audit-log decisions to the correct store.
